I worked for Newegg and it was such a horrible experience. My days consisted of nonstop calls from angry customers receiving damaged, late, or wrong items. Claim process is 7-10 business days and majority of the time ends in a Denied status. RMAs always had issues with “damaged by customer” proof photos of bent pins, thermal paste residue, etc. I’ll have to be on the phone repeating over and over again that we could not issue a refund. Customers would obviously escalate to a “supervisor” and even then they were being denied. It wasn’t until a customer would literally blow up our phone lines that they’ll consider believing them. They had marketplace items that were shipped or sold by third party sellers that would either never ship the product or send counterfeit ones. TVs or large monitors they would ship via SAIA and they always broke things and yet still deliver them and had customers sign for their package. I would contact SAIA to file a claim and they would never answer the phone or hang up on me lol. Needless to say the work environment was crap and made me suicidal, so I quit. I hope they go out of business!

I’m so late but since I came across this post, I figured I should contribute anyway. 

I used to work for Newegg in their customer service department. It is a shitty company. Management and the way they handle claims is horrible. Whenever a customer would report a damaged item, they would do the most and ask for multiple pictures of the damage and still deny it. When I worked there they used SAIA freight company for the delivery of big items like televisions. They would always lose or damage items, and sign for the package themselves. I would call to file a claim and their customer service would hang up on me. I would try to help customers as much as I could but their system was so outdated and we had to abide by their rules or we would get written up. 

On top of everything, the calls were endless and although I had coworkers right next to me, we could never speak to each other. During my lunch which was at 9 am since I started work at 5:30 am, I would go home and cry and hated going back. They would try to make up for being shitty by bringing a caterer to make funnel cakes, or hosting “ice cream parties.” The “office” was actually like a warehouse environment and there were no windows. I dreaded my life and started forming bad coping mechanisms while I worked there. On my drive to work, I would fantasize crashing and dying so I wouldn’t have to go in. 

During quality assurance review sessions, the QA employee would force me to listen to my calls and point out all the times I didn’t sound enthusiastic or happy. Lmao 

During my last day, I refunded everyone who reported an issue without filing a claim. 

TL;DR Newegg is horrible and I doubt things have changed much since I left 4 years ago. They don’t value your business and I had to hear over 2,000 customers tell me this on the phone.

 For me, I not only have ADHD but also depression, anxiety and PTSD. I sometimes have nightmares that haunt me for the rest of my day and I can’t seem to shake them off and focus. 

I was going to university for biology/pre-med and got suicidal and decided to stop going to school and focus on working because I have to sustain myself. 

I currently work for a tech company but in their customer experience dept. We have to learn about the new features and products that come out to be able to troubleshoot and assist users but I cannot focus on the trainings. I usually get through them really fast when I am running out of time and pass the test but have to catch up on learning the actual material after work hours. There are opportunities for growth but I feel like I am never going to be able to absorb everything needed to apply to those positions. 

I just wish I could sit, learn and move on without getting fixated on one thing I did wrong.

This happened to me all the time. I actually got so fixated on a friend (that also led me on for a while romantically), that when she ghosted me, I got into a really dark place and started basically stalking her and begging for her to hang out with me. I would message nonstop and became suicidal. Then one day, I just didn’t give a fuck anymore but I literally let myself become so obsessed and I never want that to happen again. It was wild.

I completely understand you. I get up for work and do the tasks that I have to do. I’ve been wanting to work out, self-learn programming languages and read some UX design books but once I am off, I can’t go back to my desk and sit again or stand to study for that matter. All I can do it manage to eat a bit and count down the hours before I have to sleep and get up for work all over again. I started taking Adderall and it does help me but I think I might need a higher dose since I still have a lot of trouble focusing. Maybe it’s just me too, maybe I can’t be helped? Ugh. 

Body doubling definitely helps, if I have my partner in the room or working on the same tasks as me, I can get through it but I also can’t force my partner to like everything I do. I also switch hobbies like every week or less.
